subject: Renewal: Moving MediCore to GCP Marketplace billing
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@medicore.health>, Liz Carter <liz.carter@medicore.health>
Cc: procurement@medicore.health
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal: Moving MediCore to GCP Marketplace billing

Hi Tom / Liz,

Thanks again for the time last week. As discussed, your renewal is coming up in late March and I wanted to follow up on the option we talked about: converting your direct invoice to GCP Marketplace billing before the renewal date.

Benefits for MediCore:
- Single consolidated charge through your org (simpler P&L and finance reconciliation)
- Ability to use your existing GCP Marketplace commit and PR process, which shortens PO cycles for many of our customers
- Access to co-sell benefits and potentially better channel incentives if you opt into managed billing in the Marketplace flow

Attached is a draft marketplace quote that mirrors the pricing in your current contract but shows the SKU mapping and entitlements required for GCP. Please take a look and share any procurement constraints (PO timing, specific invoice lines required, tax form needs).

Next steps I propose:
1) Procurement confirms acceptable billing timeline (ideally we target cutover 3/15 to align with renewal window).
2) Redwood generates a marketplace listing quote + DocuSign envelope that MediCore can sign.
3) We run the entitlement mapping with your finance team to ensure SKU and usage alignment.

Can you confirm who on your side owns the PO and preferred cutover week?

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: MediCore-Marketplace-Quote-20260216.pdf

From: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@medicore.health>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Liz Carter <liz.carter@medicore.health>
Cc: procurement@medicore.health
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal: Moving MediCore to GCP Marketplace billing

Sean —

Appreciate the summary and the draft. A few quick questions from procurement/finance:

1) Pricing parity: will the marketplace quote be identical to our current line items, or will Redwood apply any marketplace listing fees / channel adjustments? We need a line-by-line explanation to attach to our internal PO.
2) Contract term: we prefer to keep the same renewal cadence (annual, 3/31 end) — will moving to Marketplace change the effective term or reset any service dates?
3) Legal: any changes to indemnity/SLAs when billing via GCP marketplace? We will need to run any new DocuSign through our legal team.

If possible, can you provide a single-page procurement checklist we can circulate? Also include the estimated lead time from signature to GCP billing activation.

Tom Nguyen
Director, Procurement — MediCore Health
tom.nguyen@medicore.health
+1 (202) 555-0122

On Mon, Feb 16, 2026 at 09:12 AM Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks again for the time last week. As discussed, your renewal is coming up...

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: grace_oconnor, naomi_feldman, laura_bennett
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Fw: MediCore procurement questions — need marketplace quote + checklist

Team — forwarding Tom's note below. Action items to support the conversion:

- Grace: can you create a marketplace quote that preserves current list pricing but shows the SKU mapping and a clear column explaining 'Redwood list' -> 'GCP marketplace SKU'? I want the procurement team to attach this to their PO.
- Naomi: need confirmation on whether there is any channel fee we would need to show separately for GCP listing (we usually fold into the price, but procurement asks explicitly). If there's a programmatic discount available for co-sell, flag that with the math.
- Laura: please prepare the 1-page procurement checklist that explains timeline, required finance forms, and the DocuSign routing we will use.

Targets: quote and checklist by EOD 2/17 so I can send to MediCore legal on 2/18.

I attached an internal entitlement mapping draft — it shows how current features map to the marketplace SKUs (for your reference). We'll need to ensure usage reporting aligns with their PO lines.

Thanks,
Sean

Attachments: Internal-Entitlement-Mapping-20260217.docx, MediCore-Procurement-Checklist-20260217.xlsx

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@medicore.health>, Liz Carter <liz.carter@medicore.health>, procurement@medicore.health
Cc: grace_oconnor, naomi_feldman, laura_bennett
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 14:08:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Renewal: Moving MediCore to GCP Marketplace billing — quote + next steps

Tom / Liz —

Thanks for the patience. Attached are the finalized items you asked for:
- MediCore-Marketplace-Quote-20260216.pdf (line-by-line parity + SKU mapping)
- MediCore-Procurement-Checklist-20260217.xlsx (single-page checklist and timeline)

Key answers:
- Pricing parity: list prices are identical to your current contract; no additional listing fee. We show an explicit column for "Marketplace routing" that explains how charges appear on your invoice.
- Term: no change to the effective service dates — your renewal cadence remains the same (next renewal 2027-03-31). Migration to marketplace is a billing route change only.
- Legal/SLAs: there is no SLA modification for standard marketplace routing; contractual terms remain as per your master services agreement. If your legal team requests, we can include a simple addendum acknowledging the billing channel.

DocuSign: I started a DocuSign envelope that covers the marketplace routing amendment and authorized billing change. Please review and sign here: https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABCDEF-123456
Estimated activation: once signed and processed by GCP (they typically take 3–5 business days), billing will appear via the marketplace on the next invoice cycle.

Proposed cutover timeline:
- 2/20: Sign marketplace amendment via DocuSign
- 2/25: GCP processes listing and confirms activation
- 3/01: Billing appears via marketplace for March usage (aligned with your renewal month)

If that timeline works, can you confirm who will sign (legal or procurement)? Also, would you like a short kickoff call on Monday 2/23 to walk through invoicing visibility in the GCP console?

Thanks — standing by to move this to signature.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: MediCore-Marketplace-Quote-20260216.pdf, MediCore-Procurement-Checklist-20260217.xlsx
